The '''Lower Wilds''' was the name given to the eastern end of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], which by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] had sunk far lower than the western end of the valley. The [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos]] and the empty [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|tomb]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] were located in the Lower Wilds.
